description: Check what a family owns or is about to buy for a baby or child against official recalls, in one call: cribs, sleepers, strollers, high chairs, toys, furniture (CPSC), infant formula and baby food (FDA), and car seats. Each item comes back with any recalls, what the notice says to do (stop using, refund, repair kit) and a status. Car seats can't be searched by name, so they come back as 'check model' with the official recall and rating pages. Safe-sleep and furniture tip-over guidance is added only when the items or the child's age call for it. Use for questions like 'is our crib or Rock n Play recalled', 'we're expecting; check our gear' or 'is this formula or dresser safe'. An empty result means none was found, not that the item is safe; never call an item safe. Not medical advice. For one car, use check_car; for a single non-kids product, check_recalls.

ages.description: The children's ages, e.g. 'newborn, 3 years'; used only to decide whether safe-sleep guidance applies

country.description: Where the family lives: United States (default), United Kingdom, Canada or an EU/EEA country

items.description: Up to 6 things, brand plus product, one per entry: 'Fisher-Price Rock n Play', 'Similac formula', 'IKEA Malm dresser', 'Graco 4Ever car seat'

name: check_kids
title: Kids: recalls and safety for baby and child gear
